verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence of access control is that admins can scope each agent's board access and audit its actions. Each agent has its own identity, so this is a native per-identity board-permission control, but it is documented only for AI agents, not human team members or roles. App OAuth scopes like `boards:read` are developer building blocks and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documented user/team roles, view-vs-edit permission levels, board/item-level permissions for human collaborators, and independent corroboration.
